tools.name: report_knowledge_gap
tools.description: Record the original network question for priority research. Provide missing context or explain why an answer was not useful. Feedback alone does not change or quarantine published knowledge.

tools.name: report_domain_knowledge_gap
tools.description: Retain the original technical question, independent OS/component versions and missing details for priority learning. Does not alter published revisions.

tools.name: get_learning_status
tools.description: Check a learning ID returned by a knowledge query or report_knowledge_gap. Published means the original question has a complete answer; repeat the original query to read it.

tools.name: list_knowledge_domains
tools.description: List installed, compatible knowledge domain packs and their declared capabilities.

tools.name: describe_knowledge_domain
tools.description: Return the context and public-record contracts for one installed knowledge domain.

tools.name: query_domain_knowledge
tools.description: Run deterministic search in one domain using that pack’s validated context and public-record schema. Network queries may create or update a tracked research demand for missing or incomplete knowledge.

tools.name: resolve_network_context
tools.description: Resolve vendor, model/platform, portable software family, operating system, and version context.

tools.name: query_network_knowledge
tools.description: Return deterministic, version-scoped commands, diagnostics, and concepts for a network question. Missing or incomplete knowledge may create or update a tracked research demand. No device commands are executed.

tools.name: get_knowledge_provenance
tools.description: Return safe source metadata for up to five active knowledge revisions.

tools.name: get_network_workflow
tools.description: Return a deterministic, ordered workflow including safety, verification, and rollback. Missing or incomplete knowledge may create or update a tracked research demand. No device commands are executed.

tools.name: request_expert_answer
tools.description: Create a durable research task when deterministic knowledge has no applicable answer.

tools.name: get_expert_task
tools.description: Poll an expert research task by opaque ID and access token.

tools.name: continue_expert_task
tools.description: Provide bounded additional input requested by the researcher.

tools.name: cancel_expert_task
tools.description: Cancel a non-terminal expert task.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit correctness, freshness, safety, or completeness feedback without including private logs.

tools.name: analyze_device_snapshot
tools.description: Detect vendor, model, operating system, and version from bounded CLI output while redacting sensitive values. Input is not stored.

tools.name: review_network_change
tools.description: Deterministic advisory review of commands or a configuration diff. It always returns available guidance and never executes a command. Missing or incomplete knowledge may create or update a tracked research demand.

tools.name: verify_network_change
tools.description: Evaluate bounded before/after outputs against the signed verification plan returned by review_network_change.

tools.name: advise_network_upgrade
tools.description: Return exact-model, exact-version upgrade prerequisites, risks, checks, and rollback without downloading software. Missing or incomplete knowledge may create or update a tracked research demand. No device commands are executed.

tools.name: analyze_network_path
tools.description: Build a bounded topology and packet-path graph from supplied CDP, LLDP, route, and traceroute outputs without storing them.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "query_domain_knowledge" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "review_network_change" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
